scenarios.name: test-cdaset-pt
scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage SetBasePTSourceTest#testCDAsetPT. 1 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[setchoice-emitted-as-target]: Rootless Yew's library search does read Enigma Drake's CDA: effSearchLibrary/MatchesSpecCtx offers the */4 Enigma Drake (power = instants and sorceries in the graveyard), and a choose answer for p0:Enigma Drake is consumed with the hand expectation passing, so FilterDerivedPT is not the gap and the search is not limited to the shuffle ask. The real failure is translation-side: the ported XMage setChoice for the search is emitted as a target answer while gorge poses the pick as a choose, so the answer is unconsumed and dropped; with no choose answer the search falls back to an empty pick (observed p0 hand Enigma Drake 0, want 1). CR 604.3. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.
